name: 百灵中枢
description: 通过百灵中枢（BailingHub），让 WorkBuddy 查询和操作你已接入的业务后台；最终权限与业务规则仍由你的系统决定。
description_zh: 通过百灵中枢（BailingHub），让 WorkBuddy 查询和操作你已接入的业务后台；最终权限与业务规则仍由你的系统决定。
description_en: Let WorkBuddy operate systems connected to BailingHub while your system keeps final control.
examples_zh: 查看商城最近 7 天订单，整理需要关注的订单
查询指定商品的库存，先告诉我是否支持修改
把指定商品的展示标题改为我确认的文案；需要审批时先报告进度
继续查看刚才那次操作的结果，不要重复提交
examples_en: Review the last seven days of shop orders and flag orders needing attention
Check stock for the selected product and whether an update is available
Change the selected product title to the wording I confirmed; report any required approval
Check the original operation result without submitting a duplicate
